mainEntity.name: Do I need GEO services if my accounting firm only serves clients remotely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even if your accounting firm serves clients remotely, GEO services can still be beneficial. Many remote clients still prefer to find professionals who are licensed or based in their specific state or region, or who operate within similar time zones. Optimizing for local terms in your primary service areas, even without a physical storefront there, can help build trust and relevance. It positions your firm as an accessible option for those local clients who prefer remote services but like the idea of a local connection. We operate in major cities like New York City, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, and Phoenix, which can be strategic target areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, even for remote accounting firms, GEO services help attract clients who prefer professionals licensed or based in their region, or within specific time zones, building trust and relevance.
